description: Erection of first floor extension and single storey rear extension, alterations to fenestration to create a two-storey house, following demolition of existing conservatory to rear
decision_conditions: The proposed development, by reason of its relationship to and projection beyond the shared boundary with the neighbouring property at no. 113 Westland Avenue, would be an intrusive and unneighbourly development that would have an adverse impact on the amenity of these adjacent occupiers through appearing as a dominant and overbearing form of development from their rear garden environment that would result in a sense of enclosure, overshadowing and a loss of light, contrary to Local Plan Policy 7 and the Residential Extensions and Alterations Supplementary Planning Document.

Statement Required by Article 35 (2) of the Town and Country Planning (Development Management Procedure) (England) Order 2015: Consideration was given to seeking amendments, but given conflict with adopted planning policy, notification of intended refusal and the reason for it was given to the agent Gary Cumberland via email on 01/05/2026.
